title.en: Business risks and starting a business

hook.en: A mango trader buys a whole orchard's crop in March. A hailstorm in April could wipe it out, or a bumper market could double his money. Every business lives with such uncertainty.
hook.kn: ಮಾವಿನ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿ ಮಾರ್ಚ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡೀ ತೋಟದ ಬೆಳೆ ಖರೀದಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಏಪ್ರಿಲ್‌ನ ಆಲಿಕಲ್ಲು ಮಳೆ ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ನಾಶ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು ಅಥವಾ ಉತ್ತಮ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಹಣವನ್ನು ದ್ವಿಗುಣಗೊಳಿಸಬಹುದು. ಪ್ರತಿ ವ್ಯವಹಾರವೂ ಇಂತಹ ಅನಿಶ್ಚಿತತೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಬದುಕುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: Nature and causes of business risk

body.en: Business risk is the possibility of inadequate profits or even losses due to uncertainties. It is an essential part of every business, its degree depends on the nature and size of the business, and profit is the reward for bearing it. Its causes are natural, human, economic and other causes such as political disturbances or exchange-rate changes.

points.en: Other: political disturbance, mechanical failure, exchange rates

narration.kn: ಅನಿಶ್ಚಿತತೆಗಳಿಂದ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಲಾಭ ಅಥವಾ ನಷ್ಟವಾಗುವ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆಯೇ ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಅಪಾಯ. ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ನೈಸರ್ಗಿಕ, ಮಾನವ, ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಇತರ ಕಾರಣಗಳಿವೆ.

body.en: An entrepreneur must decide the line of business, its size, the form of organisation, the location, how to finance it, the physical facilities, the plant layout, a competent and committed workforce and tax planning, and then launch the enterprise.

problem.en: A garment exporter in Bengaluru faces: (a) a strike by factory workers, (b) the rupee strengthening against the dollar, (c) a cyclone delaying a ship, (d) a rival introducing cheaper fabric. Classify each cause of risk.

steps.en: (a) A strike is caused by people: human cause.
(b) Change in exchange rate: other cause.
